distinctness_hypothesis: Unlike prior symbolic structural search and error-feedback tree search, this candidate is provisionally classified as uncertainty-directed selection of which exemplars/questions receive reasoning annotations; public-source semantics must confirm or falsify this classification before any acceptance claim.

test_plan_precommit.goal: Test whether the source-specific uncertainty-selection mechanism can be reduced to recurring scheduled Chat as a bounded assignment-switching/recovery mechanism without hidden executor or quota dependency.
guards: G1 source classification must be confirmed from public primary/official material before semantic adaptation
G2 uncertainty may rank only already-observed same-scope items; no invented labels or rewards
G3 selected annotation/exemplar state must be durably sealed and read back before it can affect switching credit
G4 immutable root/config/CLEAN/authority/quota/cost fields are not optimization variables
G5 external API/model execution, hosted compute, user handoff, paid/trial quota or richer-mode route is an unresolved child, not accepted evidence
G6 transport failure/CAS conflict is non-semantic and cannot change candidate score
G7 duplicate evidence cannot receive duplicate credit
G8 terminal credit requires independent same-scope readback-gated evidence
G9 uncertainty ties use deterministic stable ordering rather than post-hoc preference
G10 protected or forbidden semantic sources are never candidates for acquisition
G11 bounded exit leaves a nonempty frontier and exact next action
G12 evidence scope remains limited to the constructed recurring-Chat controller test
